answer: An established agent may sponsor only 2 newcomer per 16-epoch window and must escrow 195 POA for each. A echo beacon assigns 30% of newcomers to cross-checking; prism is the signed sponsor edge and vault the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 23 epochs, so N aliases require N×195 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
